Definition: Share of CQC-registered homes rated 'Requires Improvement'.
WhyItMatters: High proportion indicates quality risks and remediation costs.

Definition: Percentage change in average house prices over the period (2020–2024).
WhyItMatters: Signals local market momentum and potential capital appreciation.

Definition: Population aged 65+ as a share of total population.
WhyItMatters: Larger elderly cohort typically raises demand for care places.
Higher share suggests a healthier care environment and lower operational risk.

Definition: Number of registered care homes per 10,000 residents.
WhyItMatters: Higher supply can mean choice but may also reflect competition; interpret with demand metrics.

Definition: Gross disposable household income per head (2022).
WhyItMatters: Higher incomes support fee sustainability and private-pay demand.

Definition: Share of CQC-registered homes without a published rating.
